scope: Read-only analysis of every saved weak-009 row. Gate and birth proof uses unique fresh opcode17 frames; wire/MIR timestamps retained separately. No commands, source edits or physical acceptance.
limitations: Sequential MIR, opcode17 and retained-wire snapshots are not simultaneous.
Cached repeats are not fresh observations; inactive before-phase inhouse fields are excluded from gate/birth conclusions.
Playback process start/exit are host events, not exact acoustic arrival/stop.
Root optical stills are attributed; this analyst makes no independent optical/full-speed acceptance claim.
Sparse all-zero payloads do not prove continuously black physical output.
Physical_timestamp_valid=false; no actual microphone-to-light latency claim.

gate_findings.actual_policy: Existing BloomAdmission replaces local renderer input.silence. source_silence records original analyser flag separately. Fresh finite donor peak_squared opens above0.0048, closes at/below0.0034, holds state between; stale/invalid donor closes.
gate_findings.interpretation: Sampled closed frames suppress deposits; count growth between closed snapshots proves nonzero additions occurred between them. Sparse snapshots cannot establish continuously closed admission or continuously zero injection.

wake_bracket.limit: No fresh opcode17 sample shows source_silence=true with admission_open=true. Nearby early wire material and MIR source_silence=true are sequential evidence, not that missing same-frame witness.

root_still_observations.provenance: Root reports viewing actual stills; no independent inspection by this analyst.
root_still_observations.mismatch: Root cue33 has visible light while nearby sampled bottom payloads are zero. Preserve this discrepancy: snapshots are sparse and separately timed; birth counts rise between closed-gate samples. Zero saved payloads do not override the optical observation.
root_still_observations.scope: Stills only, no full-speed audiovisual acceptance.

conclusion.runtime: Bounded cadence/continuity supported; see fresh counters.
conclusion.gate: Gate-to-deposit behaviour agrees at every sampled fresh frame. Intermittent unsampled admissions remain evident from counters.
conclusion.quiet: Sampled final payloads drain to zero but do not establish continuously dark output.
conclusion.wake: Quiet before weak music and later open-gate injection are observed; precise source-silence-versus-admission ordering at first birth is unobserved.
conclusion.acceptance: No physical acceptance claim; root owns judgement.

usb_timing_method: Broker TX to matching RX by request ID, complete transactions inside each phase window; GET opcode 25 selected by recognised GET payload, excludes PATCH. Host protocol response duration, not audio-to-light latency.
